title: 通用汽车转板纳斯达克：不花数亿美元，只为挤进指数队列？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It is part about trying to get it sort of tech glow that they've been pushing for for a while as they talk about their self-driving technology, their electric vehicles,
segments.zh: 部分是为了获得他们一直推动的科技光环，他们谈论自动驾驶技术、电动汽车，

segments.en: and their software-roaded services development. I think a bigger piece of this though really is getting into the NASDAQ 100 and getting some shareholders access to that index
segments.zh: 以及软件道路服务开发。但我认为更大的一部分是进入纳斯达克100指数，让一些股东能够接触该指数，

segments.en: so that they can maybe push the stock price up by having more possible buyers for the shares.
segments.zh: 这样他们或许能通过增加权益资产潜在买家来推高股价。

segments.en: Being part of the queues. Okay, sales is wondering. Is there a cost associated to the company for doing this, David, because other than the psychological like we've been on the New York
segments.zh: 成为队列的一部分。好的，Sales想知道，公司这样做是否有成本，David？因为除了心理上的，我们一直在纽约

segments.en: Stock Exchange since the beginning of time? No, I don't think. If there is, it's not material.
segments.zh: 证券交易所上市以来？不，我不这么认为。如果有，也不重大。

segments.en: They didn't say they had to pay hundreds of millions of dollars to get on this thing.
segments.zh: 他们没有说必须支付数亿美元才能上市。

segments.en: I think they'll probably be listed in December, so maybe one of the perks is it can happen pretty fast and they can get into the 100 when they do the rebalancing of it next month or two months.
segments.zh: 我认为他们可能会在12月上市，所以也许一个好处是它可以很快发生，他们可以在下个月或两个月内进行再平衡时进入100指数。

segments.en: We're almost in November and maybe we'll help the shares. I can't see it helping a lot. I mean, GM's in a position where they're kind of trading on the economy right now and there are a lot
segments.zh: 我们快到11月了，也许这会帮助股价。我看不出会有很大帮助。我的意思是，通用汽车目前的情况是，它们某种程度上受经济影响，而且有很多

segments.en: of worries out there with affordability and inflation and where the health and confidence of the consumer is. So maybe over time it helps them. I think it's going to be tough sweating going
segments.zh: 关于可负担性、通胀以及消费者健康和信心的担忧。所以也许随着时间的推移会有所帮助。我认为未来所有那些权益资产都会很艰难。

segments.en: forward for all those stocks. Yeah, in the Bloomberg news story that you helped author Alice from JP Morgan say that GM's market cap would make it the second largest
